final:
-- Deterministic record ids. Same seed, same ids. Ids are distinct
-- because id i is base_id(seed) + i, and base_id stays below 10^9
-- while n is at most 10^6, so no id overflows or collides.

base_id(seed: int) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  post out < 1000000000
  ex base_id(0) >= 0
  let s = seed % 999999937
  (s * 2654435761 + 1013904223) % 999999937

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  pre n <= 1000000
  post out.len() == n
  ex make_ids(0, 42) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 1) == make_ids(3, 1)
  let base = base_id(seed)
  var ids: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    ids.append(base + i)
  ids

test_make_ids() =
  assert make_ids(3, 1) == make_ids(3, 1)
  assert make_ids(0, 5).len() == 0
